meta.description: The 181st Munitions Flight's mission is to safely and expediently provide real-world and training munitions to eight active custodian accounts, including two geographically separated units. The Munitions Flight administrative offices are located in building 61, storage locations are in buildings 91 and 91B, within the controlled MSA area. Building 92, also within the MSA, is the operating location.
